newsitem.title: USA: HSN Home Shopping CFO McKeon to leave.
newsitem.headline: HSN Home Shopping CFO McKeon to leave.

text.p: HSN Inc said on Wednesday that Kevin McKeon, chief financial officer of its Home Shopping Network unit would leave the company.
Jed Trosper would assume the newly created role of CFO for both HSN and The Home Shopping Network, it said.

Since 1990, Trosper served as CFO of the portfolio companies of General Atlantic Partners, including Record World, Inc, Comprehensive Learning Concepts Inc and most recently Blessing White, the company said.
HSN said McKeon would continue to work as a consultant for the Home Shopping Network for the next several months to assist in the transition.
"Following the completion of the recent merger, I felt that this was the right time for me to leave the company to pursue other opportunities," he said.
